key.query: What audit methods are used to identify maternal mortality across different socioeconomic settings?

evidence.title: PubMed 27696682 [abstract]
evidence.cited_text: There is substantial evidence across different healthcare contexts that social determinants of health are strongly associated with morbidity and mortality in the United States.

evidence.title: PubMed 23371439 [abstract]
evidence.cited_text: Maternal serum protein profiling using proteomics may allow non-invasive diagnostic testing for the most common trisomies and may complement ultrasound-based methods to more accurately determine pregnancies with fetal aneuploidies

evidence.title: PubMed 26152007 [abstract]
evidence.cited_text: The detection of fetal RhD status by using a non-invasive method from maternal circulation was found to be possible. Assessing fetal RhD status non-invasively by using free fetal DNA in maternal blood will be cost-efficient, avoiding unnecessary indirect Coombs test and unnecessary Rhogam applications that is used in RH incompatible pregnancies.
